0022600168.text: The Spurs (3-2, on a three-game winning streak, 1-2 at home) host the Utah Jazz (1-5, on a four-game losing streak), with San Antonio 8th in the West and Utah 14th. San Antonio will be without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise). The Spurs lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after winning the 2025-26 series 2-1, and their most recent meeting was a 117-111 win in Salt Lake City.
